source.title: Breakfast at the café (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)

source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder in contemporary Bokmål (2005 norm); not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Norwegian written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. Facts about Norway and Bergen are general knowledge and unchecked. The English lines are the drafter's own.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". This unit orders with "Jeg vil ha …", the form Stage 0 uses. "Kan jeg få …?" comes later.

sentences.text: Sam og Anna er på kafé. Kafeen er stor. Det er morgen.
sentences.english: Sam and Anna are at a café. The café is big. It is morning.

sentences.text: Sam er sulten. Anna er trøtt, men hun er glad.
sentences.english: Sam is hungry. Anna is tired, but she is happy.

sentences.text: God morgen! Hva vil du ha, Anna?
sentences.english: Good morning! What would you like, Anna?
sentences.speaker: serv

sentences.text: Jeg vil ha kaffe og brød med ost.
sentences.english: I want coffee and bread with cheese.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Og du, Sam? Hva vil du ha?
sentences.english: And you, Sam? What would you like?
sentences.speaker: serv

sentences.text: Jeg vil ha te med melk.
sentences.english: I want tea with milk.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Vil du ha brød?
sentences.english: Do you want bread?
sentences.speaker: serv

sentences.text: Ja, jeg vil gjerne ha brød med ost.
sentences.english: Yes, I would like bread with cheese.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Vær så god.
sentences.english: Here you are.
sentences.speaker: serv

sentences.text: Takk!
sentences.english: Thank you!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Anna spiser brød. Sam spiser brød også.
sentences.english: Anna eats bread. Sam eats bread too.

sentences.text: Anna drikker kaffe. Sam liker melk.
sentences.english: Anna drinks coffee. Sam likes milk.

sentences.text: Er du mett nå, Sam?
sentences.english: Are you full now, Sam?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Nei, nå er jeg ikke mett. Jeg vil ha mer brød.
sentences.english: No, now I am not full. I want more bread.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg er mett. Men jeg vil ha mer kaffe.
sentences.english: I am full. But I want more coffee.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg vil ha mer te.
sentences.english: I want more tea.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Kafeen er bra!
sentences.english: The café is good!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, jeg liker kafeen.
sentences.english: Yes, I like the café.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Nå går vi til kirka.
sentences.english: Now we are going to church.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Lars er ikke på kafé. Han er på skolen.
sentences.english: Lars is not at a café. He is at the school.

sentences.text: Han er lærer, og han er trøtt i dag. Han vil ha kaffe.
sentences.english: He is a teacher, and he is tired today. He wants coffee.

sentences.text: Nils er også på skolen. Han liker ikke kaffe.
sentences.english: Nils is at the school too. He does not like coffee.

sentences.text: Nils vil ha brød og melk. Han er sulten.
sentences.english: Nils wants bread and milk. He is hungry.

sentences.text: Hei, Nils! Hva vil du ha?
sentences.english: Hi, Nils! What do you want?
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Jeg vil ha brød med ost, takk!
sentences.english: I want bread with cheese, please!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Vær så god.
sentences.english: Here you are.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Takk, Lars! Du er glad i dag.
sentences.english: Thanks, Lars! You are happy today.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ja, jeg er glad. Men jeg er trøtt.
sentences.english: Yes, I am happy. But I am tired.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Fru Berg kommer til kafeen. Hun kommer fra kirka.
sentences.english: Mrs Berg is coming to the café. She is coming from church.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Hvem er mora di, Anna?
sentences.english: Who is your mother, Anna?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Huset til Anna har et stort vindu.
sentences.english: Anna's house has a big window.
